name: 44270 · Rittman, OH
findings: ZIP 44270 (Rittman) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44270 (Rittman) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44270 (Rittman) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
